upright.short: Chance, opportunity, beginning of the end, honesty, determination.
upright.general: The card is characterized by an unambiguous indication of renewal, a remarkable mind, and provocation. It indicates an extraordinary personality with significant potential. It can refer to a person with a complex character, which undoubtedly sets them apart from others. Also, the card can carry a more negative character, where a person already in a difficult situation tries to complicate and aggravate everything. In more serious circumstances, they turn on their childishness instead of serious actions. The card characterizes a young person, mostly female, who has an analytical mind, is very quick-witted, energetic, and emotional.
upright.in_love: Disagreements and conflict situations occur with the Page of Swords card. All these conflicts can have a different character. If, for example, for someone this card means a divergence of views, for someone else it will bring major arguments and scandals. Of course, fatal consequences are not foreseen, just a normal argument can turn into a scandal that is too big. If this is an established family, then divorce is not excluded. Possibly, the main reason will be old grudges that unexpectedly resurface. In addition, the coldness of one partner towards another can consequently lead to a breakup. It should also be noted that a stubborn character can also become a reason for parting.
upright.in_situation: Problems are observed in relationships with work colleagues and bosses. True, the interpretation is ambiguous, much depends on the core of the matter. This can be expressed in insubordination to bosses, a fight in the team, or perhaps in the form of a struggle for a position. Only all this is not good, as you can earn a reprimand from management, and as a rule, it will be an undeserved reprimand. A person may worry about their new projects. But do not forget about the constructive side of the Page of Swords, because even in a problematic situation, you can break the usual course of things and bring something good into business, raising it to a new qualitative level.
upright.meaning_for_today: The card of the day says that you will hear criticism directed at you, and your proposals will most likely be rejected. You just need to prepare yourself for this initially so as not to get upset or go into a counterattack. By the way, criticism can turn out to be very useful, as it carries something valuable. If a person listens to the words spoken, much will become clear in their life. A moment will definitely come in a person's life when they can reveal their potential, because they have everything for it: sociability, quick wit, cleverness, and contact skills.
upright.card_advice: A person has such strong energy under the influence of the Page of Swords that it is not so easy for surrounding people to find a common language with them, and in general to have any common business. However, hiding your emotions is completely unnecessary. If a person experiences irritation for any reason, they should behave naturally. They do not need to hide their dissatisfaction behind masks. Only in the event that the problem is not fundamentally important, it is worth keeping silent and not wasting your energy on it.

reversed.general: Under the influence of this card, a person argues almost out of nowhere, behaves querulously and pettily. Unpleasant news or events are expected that will not allow already planned goals to come true. However, these troubles will be short-lived and minor, which means that any long-term serious problems are not anticipated. He or she can be presumptuous and hot-tempered depending on the situations. It is very important for a person to exercise caution in their statements, especially if they concern influential people or management. Some employees may turn out to have too 'big ears', and your own tongue can bring you a lot of trouble and problems. The reversed card speaks of cunning tricks and obstacles in affairs. A person may lose vigilance and misunderstand spoken words. They are capable of ridiculing a person close to them and causing them pain, despite the fact that nobody likes them.
reversed.in_love: The card speaks of relationships that imply sarcasm, deception, and mutual misunderstanding. The reversed Page of Swords in love testifies to negative and unpleasant information. It speaks of a situation that occurs in a person's family in a neglected state. If the family faces a divorce, then the divorce process will definitely not go without legal proceedings, insults, and reproaches. Even if two spouses sort out their relationship with each other, it won't happen without a ruckus, and expecting any favorable results is, of course, not worth it.
reversed.in_situation: The card speaks of dirty methods in work activities. A person takes on obligations and responsibilities but does not complete the assignment and weaves intrigues. The Arcana indicates that a person should treat documentation more carefully before signing anything. Do not trust everything that is promised. The card is characterized by difficult relationships with business people, and new methods in work are completely untimely. A person with this card can be characterized as an eternal student. In essence, they are a loafer hard to match, with no purpose in life. They are also called a spy and an intriguer who hides under the mask of a benevolent and polite person.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today is a day riddled with petty miscommunications, hidden agendas, or malicious gossip. Someone around you might try to twist your words or pry into your business, acting as an armchair spy or an intriguer. Be prepared for passive-aggressive remarks or sarcastic comments that aim to provoke you. Watch out for administrative mistakes, and double-check any information you receive today, as there is a high probability of minor trickery or misunderstandings.
reversed.card_advice: Keep your cards close to your chest and hold your tongue. The reversed Page of Swords warns you to be extremely mindful of what you say and to whom, as even walls have ears today. Do not engage in petty arguments, and do not waste your energy trying to counter ridicule or sarcasm with more hostility. Remain vigilant, double-check all documents before signing them, and don't take empty promises at face value. Silence and discretion are your best armor right now.
